sources.extracted_facts: Strique is an agentic AI marketing platform and AI marketing OS for growth teams. It runs one agent loop: plan the work, ship it, measure outcomes, and feed learnings into the next run. Product coverage includes paid media, SEO, content, lifecycle, reporting, research, generative content, scheduled automations, approval gates, closed-loop measurement, reusable skills, persistent memory, and interactive Canvas reports. Brand values include measurable outcomes, closed-loop learning, human control for high-stakes actions, traceability, and practical autonomy.

Keyword rows include best ai marketing tools mapped to comparison intent with directional volume 480, best ai tools for marketing mapped to comparison intent with directional volume 480, top ai marketing platforms mapped to comparison intent with directional volume 40, and ai marketing tools free mapped to product intent with directional volume 70.

The keyword research summary was generated on 2026-06-29 for https://www.strique.io, target country United States, with 228 deduped universe rows, 150 prioritized rows, 226 Keyword Planner rows, and 0 GSC query rows in that summary artifact.

The URL inventory includes 63 public Strique URLs. Relevant pages include /product, /integrations, /pricing, /security, /vs, /blog/what-is-an-ai-marketing-agent, /blog/closing-the-loop, and customer pages.

Site checks show public crawl evidence, rendered browser evidence, performance evidence, keyword demand evidence, keyword intent grouping, GSC SERP expectation evidence, and GSC measurement coverage. PostHog evidence is blocked in this artifact.

The content checklist requires one primary purpose, search intent match, natural keyword coverage, originality, evidence, useful headings, direct language, internal links, structured data, conversion fit, AI search readiness, and no visible AI artifacts. It requires claims to be backed by evidence and flags generic best or top claims without criteria, tradeoffs, or evidence.

The existing SEO automation draft uses the same Strique agent-loop framing: audit, map, prioritize, brief, ship with approval, measure, and learn. It avoids unsupported platform ranking claims and uses recommended internal links plus schema guidance.
